info.title: Task Management API
info.description: API documentation for the Task Management project. Authenticate via /api/auth/login and pass the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected endpoints.

get.summary: Get a single activity log (admin only)

post.summary: Authenticate a user and issue a Sanctum token
Revoke all tokens of the authenticated user
Send a password reset link to the user's email

200.description: Reset link dispatched (response is identical whether or not the email exists)

message.example: If that email exists, a reset link has been sent.

post.summary: Reset password using the token from the email link

get.summary: Get the currently authenticated user (Sanctum default route)

get.description: Admins see all projects; managers see only the ones assigned to them; employees are forbidden.

put.summary: Update a project (admin, or assigned manager)

get.summary: Project report — task counts, completion %, overdue, per-task breakdown
Employee report — assigned tasks, hours logged, avg completion
get.description: Employees may view only their own report; managers only employees with tasks in their projects; admins may view any.

get.summary: Dashboard statistics for the authenticated user (shape varies by role)
get.description: Returns a different payload depending on the caller's role: admin, manager, or employee.
Admins see all tasks; managers see tasks in projects assigned to them; employees see only tasks assigned to them.

post.summary: Create a task (admin or assigned manager)

put.summary: Update a task (admin or assigned manager)

delete.summary: Delete a task (admin or assigned manager)

patch.summary: Update only the status of a task
patch.description: Assigned employees, the project manager, or an admin may update task status.

get.description: Admins receive a paginated list; non-admins receive a lean active-users picker payload (up to 100).

200.description: Users list (paginated for admins, flat array for others)

password.description: Leave null/empty to keep current password

delete.summary: Delete a user (admin only; cannot delete self)

get.summary: List comments on a work log

post.summary: Add a comment to a work log (admin or managing manager)

get.summary: List work logs for a task

post.summary: Submit a work log entry for a task (assigned employee only)
post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data so that an optional `attachment` file (max 5MB) can be uploaded.
